romans.16.p1.b1.text: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.

romans.16.p1.b2.text: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, …

romans.16.p1.b3.text: … For she has been a great help to many people, including me.

romans.16.p2.b1.text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

romans.16.p2.b2.text: who have risked their lives for me. …

romans.16.p2.b3.text: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, …

romans.16.p3.b1.text: Greet Mary, who has worked very hard for you.

romans.16.p3.b2.text: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners.

romans.16.p3.b3.text: … They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.

romans.16.p4.b1.text: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.

romans.16.p4.b2.text: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ.

romans.16.p4.b3.text: Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

romans.16.p5.b1.text: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, women who have worked hard in the Lord.

romans.16.p5.b2.text: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.

romans.16.p5.b3.text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

romans.16.p5.b4.text: All the churches of Christ send you greetings.

romans.16.p6.b1.text: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.

romans.16.p6.b2.text: … But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.

romans.16.p6.b3.text: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet.

romans.16.p6.b4.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

romans.16.p7.b1.text: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.

romans.16.p7.b2.text: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

romans.16.p8.b1.text: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings.

romans.16.p8.b2.text: Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus.

romans.16.p9.b1.text: Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, …

romans.16.p9.b2.text: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets … in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith

romans.16.p9.b3.text: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.
